paite: Pathian limsakloute hoihsak bang a om ngei lou a, mikhialte lampi a leng dingh lou a, musitte tutphah a leng tu ngeiloumi ahampha hi.
heading: BU KHATNA / (Sam 1-41) / Kipahna Dik

paite: Akipahna tuh TOUPA dan ah ahi zaw a; adan thu sun leh zan in angaihtuah ngitnget hi.
Amah zaw tui luang kiang a sing suan ahun a gah zel, anah leng kau ngei lou bang ahi a; athilhih peuhmah alamzang zel ding hi.
Pathian limsakloute huchibang ahi kei ua; buhsi huih in amut lengmang bang ahi zaw uhi.
Huaiziak in mi Pathian limsakloute zaw vaihawmna ma ah adingh thei kei ding uh, mikhialte leng midiktatte omkhopna ah adingh thei sam kei ding uhi.
TOUPA'N midiktatte lampi athei naknak ngal a; mikhialte lampi bel amangthang ding hi.
